best_for: Windows 10 and 11 users who want a quick, themeable photo viewer that opens HEIC, WebP, SVG and RAW files, and who are happy with the free edition or a small one-time Pro fee.

points.title: Opens the awkward formats
points.text: ImageGlass reads more than 90 formats, including HEIC, WebP, SVG, animated GIF and camera RAW files. It preloads nearby images so stepping through a folder feels quick.

points.title: Classic stays free
points.text: The Classic edition is GPLv3 and costs nothing. It covers viewing, color management, basic HDR, crop and resize, the ExifGlass metadata viewer, themes, plugins and file associations.

points.title: Pro is a one-time price
points.text: Pro Individual is $14.90 once for one user and Pro Team $69 for up to three users, both with v10.x updates. Pro Business is billed yearly by user count, for example $290 a year for 25 users. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: What Pro adds
points.text: Pro adds an HDR tone mapper, free panning, a file watcher that reacts to folder changes, custom mouse actions, and config files and feature locks for managed or shared PCs. A 14-day trial of Pro Business is offered.

points.title: Store edition has gaps
points.text: The Pro version bought from the Microsoft Store lacks custom file type associations and icons, and has no priority support.

points.title: Windows needs version 1809 or later
points.text: The builds here are MSIX packages for x64 and Arm64 and need Windows 10 version 1809 or newer. The project also lists a macOS build for Apple silicon on macOS 14 and a Linux x64 build. The Windows listing keeps 35 versions.
